lines.en: Every year, Ross makes a toast,
and it's always really moving and always makes them cry.
Well, this year, I'm gonna make them cry.
And you-- you wonder why Ross was their favorite?
No, really. Anytime Ross makes a toast,
everyone cries and hugs him and pats him on the back,
and they all come up to me and say,
You know what they're gonna say this year?
at least one person will be crying.
and any actor worth his salt can cry on cue.
Oh, are you kidding me? Watch.
No, I can't do it with you guys watching me.
